question: Related Questions Q. Assalamu Alaikum, Dear Brother, My name is Naseer and I am working in Dubai. I am sending this question on behalf of my friend. My friend name is Shakeel Ahmed. The question is that, is it okay to put name as Muhammed Subhan for any muslim child? Recently he was advised by some people to change this name. answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 151448 Country: India Title: Name of girl child Question: I have been blessed with a girl child and we have named her SHAIK AL-RAEESA SIDDEEQAH. I want to know the meaning of this name and is it right to add prefixes like AL and what is the meaning of that. Answer ID: 151448 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1060/935/H=9/1438) Shaikh al-Raisa is not good name. keep the name of your daughter only Siddiqah only or add Juveria or Aisha etc before Siddiqah. Siddiqah means chaste and truthful woman thus it is a good name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
